review.tagline: Generates interactive classes with AI teachers and classmates from a topic or file
review.summary: OpenMAIC turns a topic or attached documents into a lesson made of slides, quizzes, interactive HTML simulations and project-based learning activities. AI teacher and classmate agents speak via TTS, draw on a whiteboard and discuss with the learner. Built on Next.js 16, React 19 and LangGraph. Since 1.2.0, course generation runs on the server and courses are stored in PostgreSQL.
review.audience: Educators and self-hosters building AI-taught courses from documents
strengths: Exports lessons as editable .pptx or interactive .html pages
Many providers: OpenAI, Anthropic, Bedrock, Gemini, Ollama, Lemonade, any OpenAI-compatible API
Models set once per slot in openmaic.yml, with lock and allowUserKeys: false options
OpenMAIC Skill lets OpenClaw and similar workbenches generate classrooms from chat apps
weaknesses: 1.2.0 needs PostgreSQL 16 and a long-running server; Vercel and serverless are unsupported
Latest 1.2.0 line is a release candidate; changelog must be read before upgrading
README recommends image, video, TTS and web search keys for full function
Compose install is single-user; shared access needs ACCESS_CODE and manual network publishing
needs: Needs PostgreSQL 16, Node.js >= 22.19, pnpm >= 10, LLM provider API key
Models: OpenAI, Anthropic, Amazon Bedrock, Google Gemini, DeepSeek
